comparison_contract.previous_check: Previous accepted completed snapshot for the same instrument, unit, basis and session policy. Show actual elapsed duration and both observation timestamps. An unchanged source timestamp is no_new_observation, not a fresh zero delta.
comparison_contract.fifteen_minutes: Baseline at or before as_of minus 15 minutes, within the existing consumer's documented tolerance (currently 120 seconds). No interpolation or future input. Missing qualifying baseline => null with reason.
comparison_contract.prior_close: Previous completed regular-session close from an exchange calendar and matching adjustment basis. Show extended-session return separately. Futures require explicit contract/roll and settlement basis; do not compare changing contracts.
comparison_contract.rates: Yield and spread deltas in basis points: 100*(current_percent-baseline_percent). Example 4.90% -> 4.95% is +5bp.
comparison_contract.prices: 100*(current/baseline-1) in percent; dollar/physical changes also displayed in native unit where useful.
comparison_contract.low_frequency: Weekly inventories/retail prices and delayed shipping estimates retain release-to-release changes and their actual effective dates. Intraday deltas are null/not_applicable rather than fabricated. Same-unrevised weekly observation is not a new intraday signal.
comparison_contract.causality: Separate observed co-movement, sourced explanation and analyst hypothesis; correlation does not establish a driver.
